lines.speaker: fens_salvager
lines.text: Platforms are firm, reeds aren't, and the difference is about a metre and about your life.

lines.speaker: fens_salvager
lines.text: Everything the Basin ever washed down comes out here eventually. Good salvage. Bad walk.

lines.speaker: fens_salvager
lines.text: Things come out of the water that look like people you knew. Don't answer them. I answered one once.
